hooks: A portfolio chart is not proof that a silver bar exists.
CoinStats documents manual portfolios and crypto centered connections.
Delta documents read-only tracking for stocks, funds, ETFs, crypto, and wallets.
A silver ETF is market exposure, not allocated bullion.
Keep serial numbers and invoices outside the market tracker.
Do not force physical coins into a ticker just to balance a dashboard.
Use an app as a view after building a custody record.
Neither reviewed product source establishes automatic bullion tracking.
